fields.summary_ko.0: Eli Lilly (LLY) stock rose 45.3% over six months from May 18 to November 16, 2025, with diabetes and obesity treatments Mounjaro and Zepbound accounting for approximately two-thirds of Q3 revenue, exceeding $16 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Starting February 2025, production capacity expansion and market share gain signals became publicly visible, with Q1 revenue reaching $12.7 billion, up 45.2% YoY.
fields.summary_ko.2: 2026 full-year growth rate has decelerated from 55.5% in Q1 to 38.6% in Q3, while U.S. obesity drug usage remains at 82% growth.
